partners.name: PropFirmConnector
partners.headline: Every Rithmic prop account, in one NinjaTrader.
partners.summary: NinjaTrader 8 natively allows one active Rithmic connection at a time, and some Rithmic prop-firm account types have no native NinjaTrader connection at all. PropFirmConnector adds a connection path for any Rithmic prop-firm or live Rithmic broker account, and runs several of them side by side in a single NinjaTrader instance.
partners.fit: Meridian runs inside NinjaTrader 8. PropFirmConnector is how prop accounts on Rithmic get into that same NinjaTrader, all at once, instead of one install or one VPS per account.

partners.name: The Forge
partners.headline: Practice the plan before real money is on it.
partners.summary: The Forge teaches a strategy in lessons, then puts you in a simulator that plays a session out candle by candle and stops when it is time to decide: long, short, or stay out. You drag your entry, stop and target onto the chart, and every practice trade is scored on whether you followed your rules, never on profit. A winner that broke a rule still loses points; sitting out a bad session correctly scores 100%.
partners.fit: The Forge builds the habit of trading your rules before the session. Meridian holds you to them during it, live, on your real account.
facts: Free plan: 40+ Foundations lessons and 25+ drills, no card
Four strategies, each with a free practice trade
Forge Pro $79/mo, with a 7-day free trial
